brief.title: State of Developer Ecosystem 2024: Language Wars & Rising Stars
brief.one_liner: A data-driven comparison of programming language trends, adoption trajectories, and the technologies reshaping the developer landscape in 2024.
brief.goal: Viewers should understand which programming languages are growing, declining, or holding steady — and grasp the key shifts in developer tooling, database preferences, and cloud adoption heading into 2025.

sections.title: Top Programming Languages (2017–2024)
sections.objective: Show the 8-year usage trajectory of the most popular languages, highlighting JavaScript's plateau, Python's rise, and TypeScript's surge.

sections.title: Rising Stars: TypeScript, Rust & the Promise Index
sections.objective: Spotlight the JetBrains Language Promise Index leaders and explain why TypeScript, Rust, and Python are the languages with the brightest outlook.

sections.title: Databases & Cloud: Where Code Runs
sections.objective: Compare the top databases (PostgreSQL's climb vs. MySQL's dominance) and cloud providers (AWS still leading but Azure gaining ground).

sections.title: Where Applications Live
sections.objective: Illustrate the split between browser, desktop, mobile, and server/cloud execution platforms, challenging the assumption that mobile dominates.

sections.title: AI in the Developer Workflow
sections.objective: Highlight that 18% of developers now build AI integrations and that Python dominates AI/ML work, with C++ as a surprising secondary player.
